description: Ray-traced Sionna channels for ns-3.40 Wi-Fi, with SU-MIMO, beamforming, MU-MIMO and reproducible validation.
rules: Use the MIMO fork and feature/su-mimo-minimal branch; upstream ns3sionna documentation may describe only the legacy scalar channel.
Target this project's modified ns-3.40 and pinned Sionna 2.2.0 / Sionna RT 2.2.0 environment; do not substitute newer APIs.
Sionna exports channels; ns-3 computes MIMO precoding, detection, SINR and packet outcomes.
CFR coefficients are serialized in [subcarrier, rx, tx] order, with tx varying fastest.
Prefer SionnaMimoHelper; distinguish the default mean-uncoded-BER mapping from explicit EESM, which requires an MCS-specific beta.
Separate implemented capabilities from validated calibration scope; do not claim general EHT or arbitrary MIMO PER calibration.
